description: MC1458 dual op-amp (two 741s in one package; TI 1989 macromodel)

source.licence: KiCad-Spice-Library collection (GPL-3.0); model by the manufacturer named, redistributed there

note: The card clips 2.0 V from each rail, about a volt sooner than a typical part (still inside the sheet's minimum). Bias & headroom uses the sheet's typical swing, so a render can clip about a volt before the pane's limit.
